//: Lives in frontend/ because that is the app root (package.json is here);
set Vercel's Root Directory to `frontend` and it will be picked up.
Build/install/output come from the create-react-app preset - do not
override them here or the preset's defaults stop applying.

headers.//: Webpack content-hashes everything under /static, so a changed file is a changed URL - it can never be served stale.

public/ assets keep a STABLE filename (the logo pieces and the sprite sheet are referenced by literal path), so `immutable` here would pin a regenerated asset for a year. One day fresh, one week of stale-while-revalidate instead: repeat visits are free and a rebuild still propagates.
The SPA shell must always be revalidated or a deploy never reaches returning users - it is what points at the hashed bundles.
